translations.web: But if the scab spreads on the skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he shall show himself to the priest again.
translations.bsb: But if the rash spreads further on his skin after he has shown himself to the priest for his cleansing, he must present himself again to the priest.
translations.kjv: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
